 Pokhara Avengers to bat first against Karnali Yaks in NPL 
 Nepal News 
 November 9, 2026 
 1 MIN READ 
 A 
 A+ 
 A- 
 content_copy 
 bookmark_border 
 KATHMANDU: Pokhara Avengers will bat first against Karnali Yaks in Monday’s Nepal Premier League (NPL) match. The decision came after Pokhara Avengers won the toss at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur. The match is scheduled to begin at 12:30 p.m.
 This match is critical for the Pokhara Avengers, who have yet to secure a victory in the tournament. Having played four matches so far, the team enters its fifth game in a must-win situation.
 Karnali Yaks, meanwhile, have recorded two wins and two losses in their four appearances. With four points, Karnali Yaks currently sits in sixth place on the points table.
